_comment: Phase 4 — the real Secret Drawer puzzle. Source of truth: Secret-Drawer-Items (NEW2).docx + Secret-Drawer-Playbook.docx (off-repo, on Thomas's Desktop). Background: the empty-compartment artwork. Every visible item is an engine overlay placed on top. Surface state flips between `clean` (#3724) and `dusty` (#3725).
